title: run-ledger-row
description: One append-only row in the v1 run ledger (~/.sutra-native/ledger/). Shape ratified in SCOPE.md §4 (B18-1, amended by the S0 gate review). S0 folds: run_id is the join key eval receipts reference; verify_template is a PINNED registry reference so later template edits never change the meaning of old evidence (G1). Writes are atomic (temp+rename); evolution is additive-only.

schema_version.description: Row schema version (all rows carry schema_version; additive-only evolution).

run_id.description: S0 fold: the join key eval-receipt rows reference (eval-receipt.run_id).

ts_open.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the atom opened.

ts_close.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the atom closed (row is written at close).

verify_template.description: S0 fold (G1): PINNED registry reference — both id and version required so later template edits never change the meaning of old evidence.

verify_args.description: Arguments the verify template was instantiated with, as name/value pairs.

workflow_ref.description: Reference to the FOLLOWED registered workflow. Nullable until registry live (CONSTRUCT / improvised runs carry null).

thread_id.description: Conversation/session thread the run belongs to.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the evidence artifact for this run; null when no evidence artifact exists.
